## Experiment Processing

```{r}
db_path <- paste0(params$input_dir, "FullHMDB_Chebi_Tripeptides_db.csv")

hermes_results_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "Hermes_Results/")
if(!dir.exists(hermes_results_path)){dir.create(hermes_results_path)}

column_ids <- c("Hilic_Positive", "Hilic_Negative", "RP_Positive")
positive_adducts <- c("M+H", "M+NH4", "M+Na", "M+K", "M+")
negative_adducts <- c("M-H", "M+Cl")

gfcv_exp <- list()
lima_exp <- list()

for(id in column_ids){
    output_path <- paste0(hermes_results_path, id, "/")    
    if(!dir.exists(output_path)){dir.create(output_path)}
    
    file_dir <- paste0(params$input_dir, id, "/")
    hermes_files <- paste0(file_dir, "Hermes_Files/")
    
    hermes_output_path <- paste0(output_path, "filteredSoiLists.rds") 
    ## HERMES Analysis
    if(!file.exists(hermes_output_path)){
        param_list <- list(ms1_dir = hermes_files, 
                            qc_names =  "QC", blank_names = "Blank",
                            met_db = db_path, met_db_sep = ",",
                            ppm_error = 10, instrument = "QTOF", resolution = 30000, 
                            noise_int = 1000, labelled = FALSE,
                            min_max_mz = c(50, 1500), 
                            add_charge = 1, add_mult = 1,
                            soi_detection_type = "double",
                            output_dir = output_path,
                            consensus = TRUE, 
                            soi_consensus = 1:3)
        param_list$ionization <- ifelse(grepl("Positive", x = id, 
                                                ignore.case = TRUE), 
                                        "+", "-")
        param_list$ad_list <- ifelse(grepl("Positive", x = id, 
                                                ignore.case = TRUE), 
                                        positive_adducts, negative_adducts)
        rmarkdown::render(input = "./Hermes_Analysis.Rmd",
                      output_file = paste0(output_path, "Hermes_Report.html"), 
                      clean = TRUE, params = param_list)
    }
    
    ## XCMS Analysis
    metadata_path <- paste0(file_dir, "LC_MS_metadata.csv")
    xcms_hermes_output_path <- paste0(output_path, "summarized_hermes_xcms.rds")
    
    if(!file.exists(xcms_hermes_output_path)){
        param_list <- list(
            file_dir = file_dir,
            metadata_file = metadata_path,
            output_dir = output_path
        )
            
        rmarkdown::render(input = "./XCMS_Analysis.Rmd",
                  output_file = paste0(output_path, "XCMS_Analysis.html"), 
                  clean = TRUE, params = param_list)    
    }
    
    ## XMCS-HERMES Analysis
    untargeted_lima_output <- paste0(output_path, "xcms_hermes_exp_lima.rds")
    untargeted_gfcv_output <- paste0(output_path, "xcms_hermes_exp_gfcv.rds")
    
    if(!file.exists(untargeted_gfcv_output)){
        param_list <- list(
            metadata_file = metadata_path,
            xcms_hermes_file = xcms_hermes_output_path,
            hermes_file = hermes_output_path,
            output_results = output_path
        )
        switch(id, "Hilic_Positive" = {
            param_list$qc_name <- "HP_QC"
            param_list$blank_name  <- "HP_Blank"
            param_list$data_type <- "Hilic_Positive"
        }, "Hilic_Negative" = {
            param_list$qc_name <- "HN_QC"
            param_list$blank_name <- "HN_Blank"
            param_list$data_type <- "Hilic_Negative"
        }, "RP_Positive" = {
            param_list$qc_name <- "RP_QC"
            param_list$blank_name <- "RP_Blank"
            param_list$data_type <- "RP_Positive"
        })
        
        rmarkdown::render(input = "./XCMS_HERMES_Post_Processing.Rmd", 
                      output_file = paste0(output_path, "xcms_hermes_results.html"), 
                      clean = TRUE, params = param_list, envir = new.env())
    }

    gfcv_exp[[id]] <- readRDS(untargeted_gfcv_output)
    lima_exp[[id]] <- readRDS(untargeted_lima_output)
}
####
gfcv_exp <- Reduce(combineRows, gfcv_exp)
assay(gfcv_exp) <- as.data.frame(assay(gfcv_exp))

saveRDS(gfcv_exp, paste0(params$output_dir, "Untargeted_Metabolomics_exp_gfcv.rds"))
####
lima_exp <- Reduce(combineRows, lima_exp)
assay(lima_exp) <- as.data.frame(assay(lima_exp))

saveRDS(lima_exp, paste0(params$output_dir, "Untargeted_Metabolomics_exp_lima.rds"))
```
